title: Online backups of large campaigns now save
summary: Saving a campaign larger than 2 MB to My account → Backups used to fail with a general error. Large backups are now stored in pieces and download and restore exactly like any other online backup.
items: The per-campaign limit of 3 online backups and your account's backup storage apply as before; a replaced backup is removed only after the new one is completely saved.
Backups saved earlier read as before.
